Run the Cross-App Access (ID-JAG) debugger: self-issue an ID-JAG, redeem it at the target authorization server (RFC 7523), and cal
l the MCP server with the resulting access token. See the [XAA Debugger guide](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/xaa.md) for the trust s
etup, registration strategies, and CI usage.
An unknown ID, or an ID or flag for a suite the run leaves out, is a usage error (exit code `2`) before anything runs.
| `--server <name=url>` | | Bind a target server to an HTTP(S) URL. Repeatable. Split on the first `=`; duplicate or unknown names
are usage errors. |
Global `--timeout` bounds each setup operation and MCP request, not the whole run. Exit codes: `0` passed, `1` failed, `2` usage/u
nsupported/import/policy, `3` credentials, `4` setup/billing/artifact, `5` inconclusive or interrupted; see [Exit codes](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md#exit-codes).
`--host` is a usage error rather than a silent precedence rule.
Launch a goal run. **Spends model credits**: fans out into `targets × iterations` chat sessions.
| `--expected-sponsored <n>` | No | How many of this launch's conversations you expect to be sponsored (paid from MCPJam's per-use
r allowance instead of your organization's credits). If the actual split differs, the launch is refused with a `409` and nothing i
s created. Omit to accept whatever split applies. |
Grade a saved server against a publisher's directory as the platform reaches it, through the saved server row and the authorize ex
change. This is the hosted half of `readiness check`: it answers a different question (what the platform sees, not what your machi
ne sees), can optionally run a model for experience observations (included with MCPJam; no credits are consumed), and leaves a per
sistent record.
| `--ai-observations` | No | Add optional model observations. **Consumes MCPJam credits.** |
| `--ai-observations` | No | Add optional model observations. **Consumes MCPJam credits.** |
| `--claim <feature>` | Declare a feature the server offers, so the report shows it as claimed. One of `lazy-authentication` or `e
nterprise-managed-auth`. Repeat to claim several (at most 10). An unknown value is a usage error. |
| `--file <path>` | No | Path to a **create-API JSON** body (or `-` for stdin). A versioned suite file (`schemaVersion: "1"`) belo
ngs on `eval run --file` |
| `--client <id-or-name...>` | No | Clients to attach the suite to (overrides the file). Without one the suite lists no client, an
d `eval run --client` has nothing to select |
### `cloud eval run`
Start an eval run of an existing suite, or upload a versioned suite file and run it. Provide **either** `--suite` **or** `--file`,
not both.
